description:
## 1.0.1

Fixes Morphe Manager bundle loading: adds Android DEX and bundle name/version metadata. Verified with Manager 2.3.0's patcher on Android 35. Gameplay patch logic and the target (stock Tracket 0.9.38, versionCode 237) are unchanged.

This is a client-side patch, not a genuine Google Play purchase. Servers may still refuse the account. Please support the original developer.

patches.name: Unlock lifetime
patches.description: Seeds a lifetime entitlement grant and skips the Play license check.

release_notes: Fixes missing Android DEX and missing bundle name/version metadata reported in #5. Includes Java classes for desktop and classes.dex for Android. Verified by desktop patch discovery, DEX instruction decoding, and the Morphe Manager 2.3.0 patcher loading the bundle on Android 35. Gameplay patch logic and supported Tracket version (0.9.38) are unchanged. This release does not claim patched-app runtime verification.
repoDescription: Morphe patches for Tracket 0.9.38. Unlock lifetime is a client-side grant for that version.
